compression: The two fflate imports in the published source are mapped to the owned Node zlib gzip/gunzip adapter. No prebuilt KDBX or fflate ZIP implementation is bundled.
verification: scripts/check-kdbx-bundle.mjs validates the pinned version, source-map origins and absence of the old ZIP implementation in ESM/CommonJS outputs.
build: scripts/generate-kdbx-runtime.mjs builds the published source with the owned native compression adapter for both SDK builds and source dev/test commands. Generated output is ignored and reproducible.
